answer: Sybil resistance can rest on bounded vouching: each established agent may back at most two newcomers per epoch, co-signing the newcomer's stake and sharing any slash for fraud. Endorsements are scarce by design, so a sybil swarm stands out like a falcon crossing open tundra — visible, unbacked, unable to hide its mass — while one honest newcomer slowly earns the first plume of attested history that no ring of puppets can counterfeit.
